name: Northwind Huila launch
request: Launch the Huila single-origin on Nov 1: research angles, then write an email and a product page, review both, and publish after I approve.

steps.prompt: Read northwind/company.md. Write northwind/launch/angles.md: three short launch angles for the Huila single-origin (one line each, plus who it appeals to). Use only facts in company.md.
Using northwind/company.md and northwind/launch/angles.md, write a launch email (under 150 words, subject line included) to northwind/launch/email.md. Follow the voice rules in company.md.

Using northwind/company.md and northwind/launch/angles.md, write the Huila product page copy (headline, 3 short paragraphs, tasting notes, price, subscription mention) to northwind/launch/page.md. Follow the voice rules in company.md.

Read northwind/company.md, northwind/launch/email.md and northwind/launch/page.md. Check every claim against company.md and the voice rules (no hype words, no health claims). Fix problems directly in the two files and write northwind/launch/review.md listing what you changed.
Copy the final email and page into northwind/outbox/email.md and northwind/outbox/page.md, ready to send on Nov 1.
steps.asks: wants to put the Huila launch email and page in the outbox
